description.v: Mindgrove Technologies is a fabless semiconductor design startup building high-performance System-on-Chips (SoCs) in India. Products include Secure IoT (28nm microcontroller SoC), Vision SoC (edge computing/vision processing), and Edge Compute processors. Based on Shakti RISC-V core developed at IIT Madras.
description.note: Synthesized from website and multiple news sources.

employee_estimate.note: No employee count found in any fetched source. Company mentions expanding team across all departments.

hq_type.note: Headquartered at IIT-Madras Research Park, Chennai.

conflicts.claim_a: Fabless chip design; Secure IoT SoC for biometrics/industrial IoT
conflicts.claim_b: Fabless chip design; Secure IoT SoC for biometrics/industrial IoT, vision, edge computing
conflicts.resolution: phase3 p3 payload disagrees with existing value; existing kept as preferred pending human review
2021 preferred — multiple primary sources (TOI, Business Standard, IndianWeb2) state 2021; IndianStartupNews is T3 and likely less reliable.
$2.325 million preferred — TOI and The Hindu both report $2.325M; IndianStartupNews says $2.35M.
Both refer to same person; 'Sharan Jagathrakshakan' appears to be full name, 'Sharan Srinivas J.' is abbreviated form used by multiple sources.

events.description: Preparing commercial production of Secure IoT chip; Bosch field trials reported in sector roundup.
events.headline: Commercial production prep; Bosch field trials
Seed funding of $2.325M announced
events.description: Mindgrove Technologies raised $2.325 million in seed funding led by Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Speciale Invest, and Whiteboard Capital.

events.headline: ₹19.5 crores raised from seed round
events.description: Bar and Bench reports Mindgrove raised ₹19.5 crores from Speciale Invest Continuity, Whiteboard Capital, Sequoia and other investors in a cross-border transaction involving India, Singapore, Mauritius.

events.headline: Secure IoT SoC launched
events.description: India's first commercial-grade high-performance microcontroller SoC taped out at 28nm, designed for smart connected devices.

events.headline: Series A of $8M announced
events.description: Mindgrove raised $8 million (Rs 64 crore) in Series A co-led by Rocketship.vc and Speciale Invest, with participation from Mela Ventures, Peak XV Partners, Nishchay Goel, Whiteboard Capital, and Anshul Goel.

events.headline: MoU signed with Prama India for CCTV cameras
events.description: Mindgrove signed MoU with Prama India Private Limited to deploy indigenously designed chips in CCTV surveillance cameras and advanced video security systems.

founders.name: Shashwath T.R.
founders.background: Electronics engineer; graduate from SRM Engineering College; worked at Lucid Software from 2006 to 2021 developing ultrasound devices, drivers, and computer vision algorithms for nuclear, oil and gas, and aerospace industries; expert in systems engineering, signal processing, and machine vision software.

founders.name: Sharan Srinivas J.
founders.background: Computer scientist; undergraduate degree in Computer Science from Meenakshi Sundararajan Engineering College, Anna University (2012); masters degree in Computational Science from ETH Zurich; worked at Lucid Software from 2016-2021 developing CUDA/OpenCL programs on NVIDIA GPUs; developed interest in high-performance scientific applications at ETH Zurich.
founders.education: Meenakshi Sundararajan Engineering College, Anna University (2012); ETH Zurich (Masters in Computational Science)
